## Code Review

This pull request implements the Stage 70 fixed VM/JIT lifecycle v2 for the Windows Hyper-V runner, introducing reversible host updates, one-job pilot orchestration, and a fixed privileged helper contract. Key feedback includes addressing a potential deadlock in `CIEPRServices.cs` by reading redirected streams asynchronously, resolving a pipeline binding issue in `Fixed-Lifecycle.ps1` when querying disk information, using a more robust method to detect active drive letters, and preventing strict-mode runtime exceptions in `Invoke-ControllerJitPilot.ps1` by verifying API response properties before access.
